kernel.variant: simdgroup attention, 4 simdgroups splitting the key range over the SAME 8 query rows

result.hypothesis: the previous receipt refuted 'scalar dot products' and proposed OCCUPANCY instead: the simdgroup kernel put 32 threads on 8 query rows where the scalar kernel puts 256 on one. That replacement diagnosis is itself a claim, so it was tested rather than left standing.
result.test: four simdgroups cooperating on the SAME 8 query rows, each owning a quarter of the key range, partial outputs summed in threadgroup memory. Same matrix instructions, 4x the threads, nothing else changed.

sg4_vs_sg1.reason: an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (sg1 27.83%, sg4 5.69%) and the margin 57.95% does not overwhelm that noise

sg4_vs_scalar.reason: an arm failed the 10.0% IQR gate (scalar 11.38%, sg4 5.69%) and the margin 3.12% does not overwhelm that noise

result.verdict: DIRECTIONALLY CONFIRMED, NOT CLEANLY MEASURED. sg1 0.420 ms -> sg4 0.266 ms is the predicted direction and roughly the predicted size, but the sg1 arm carries a 27.83% IQR so compare() returns NO_CLAIM rather than a ratio. The direction is not in doubt; the magnitude is not established.

where_it_lands.vs_scalar: NO_CLAIM at 0.266 against 0.258 -- the simdgroup version has gone from LOSING 0.70x to being INDISTINGUISHABLE from the scalar kernel, which is what fixing occupancy was supposed to buy
where_it_lands.vs_naive: BASELINE_WINS 0.9283 with clean arms -- naive still wins by 1.08x, so the fused approach does not beat three MLX calls even with occupancy repaired

result.what_this_settles_and_what_it_does_not: SETTLED: occupancy was the dominant cost of the 8-row simdgroup blocking, and restoring it recovers most of the gap. NOT SETTLED: whether fused attention can beat the naive path at all on this machine at these shapes. It still does not, and no amount of the present design appears likely to -- MLX's matmul is simply very good, and three calls into it beat one hand-built kernel.

diagnosis_scorecard.note: four diagnoses, four tested. Two clean confirmations, one refutation, one partial. None was allowed to stand as an explanation without a measurement.

claim_boundary: One shape, seq 512 head_dim 64, one machine. The occupancy fix takes simdgroup attention from losing to the scalar kernel to being indistinguishable from it, but the sg1 baseline arm was too noisy for a clean ratio and NAIVE STILL WINS by 1.08x with clean arms. No win is claimed. This does not make fused attention useful here.
